items.title: Property investors targeted in 'ambitious' budget
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers has defended negative gearing and capital gains tax changes unveiled in his fifth federal budget last night. Follow live.

items.title: How Australians across generations feel about the budget
items.description: Australians across generations, from gen Z to baby boomers, weigh in on the "intergenerational equity" budget.

items.title: Breaking a promise on negative gearing is a calculated risk
items.description: If the reforms help younger Australians believe home ownership is within reach, Labor can expect to collect a political dividend.

items.title: Live: ASX set to edge lower in first session after budget, Wall Street mixed
items.description: As the nation digests the budget, Australian shares are set for another day of losses, with the SPI futures pointing to 0.1 per cent fall by the ASX 200 after a mixed night on Wall Street. Follow our live markets blog.

items.title: The biggest shake-up to the tax system in years
items.description: It’s the budget that will create 75,000 new home owners, according to Treasurer Jim Chalmers.  But the tax changes to get there are going to set off a major political fight.  Economics reporter Tom Crowley walks you through the changes.

items.title: Starmer faces more calls to quit as ministers resign
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer is striking a defiant tone despite a growing number of his Labour colleagues urging him to step down.

items.title: Australian-born MP at centre of 'palace coup' plot to knife British PM
items.description: Up until the past few days, Catherine West kept a low profile, as far as politicians go. Most Brits would never have come across the Australian-born, London-based MP before, but that all changed at the weekend.

items.title: Live: Trump says US has Iran 'very much under control' ahead of Beijing visit
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he does not need help from Beijing to end the war with Iran but says he will talk at length with Chinese President Xi Jinping when they hold a summit this week. Follow live.

items.title: Australia insists support for UAE does not involve action against Iran
items.description: The Albanese government insists Australia is not involved in any "offensive action against Iran" amid reports the UAE, which had been supplied a Wedgetail aircraft, carried out military strikes against the country.

items.title: Breaking: 'Toxic': Plan to build 91-storey Trump Tower on Gold Coast scrapped
items.description: The branded tower proposed for Surfers Paradise would have been Australia's tallest building.

items.title: How fuel prices have impacted car sales
items.description: Electric vehicles now represent 16 per cent of new car sales in Australia, in a growing trend coinciding with record fuel prices.

items.title: Police attend 160 family violence call-outs in Melbourne's south in one week
items.description: Police say a man who threatened to kill his wife with a hammer and tried to set fire to a property was just one of dozens of arrests for family violence in a single week in the Dandenong area.

items.title: Emergency department nurse faces deportation due to son's condition
items.description: A Victorian emergency department nurse and her family face deportation before the end of the month due to her six-year-old son's developmental delay.

items.title: 'Something catastrophic is going to happen': NT mayor on car thefts spike
items.description: Katherine's mayor says residents feel less safe than they did a year ago and is calling on Northern Territory Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro to hold an "urgent" roundtable on crime in the Top End town.

items.title: Three-storey seniors unit block a threat to 'peaceful' street, locals say
items.description: New public housing units built specifically for seniors are now under construction in Sydney's south-west, despite opposition from some local residents.

items.title: The pianist fighting the MSO over right to bring whole self to stage
items.description: In 2024, Jayson Gillham's show was cancelled for his on-stage comments about Palestine. Now he brings a legal suit and a new recital tour with a Palestinian Jordanian artist.

items.title: How Broadbeach became a blues mecca
items.description: As some festivals crumble, the Gold Coast's mayor says the 25-year-old Blues On Broadbeach event isn't going anywhere.

items.title: Quiz: Dig out your passport, it's time for a whirlwind world trip
items.description: Where was the world's first permanent commercial bungee jumping site set up? And which country is home to the historic city of Timbuktu?

items.title: The name of this health condition was 'very inaccurate'. Now it's changed
items.description: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) has been renamed polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS), a move health experts say will lead to faster diagnoses and better treatment for women of all ages.

items.title: Record payout after billionaire built mine without traditional owners' permission
items.description: Andrew Forrest's Fortescue has been ordered to pay $150 million to WA traditional owners after mining their land without permission.

items.title: High Court to hear appeal over 22-year Mount Pleasant coal mine extension
items.description: The High Court will hear a major climate change case that could affect mining approvals, as the operator of the Mount Pleasant coal mine seeks to overturn a ruling blocking the project's extension.

items.title: Government accused of 'burying' response to landmark gambling report
items.description: A long-awaited response to an inquiry that called for a gambling advertising ban has been tabled on budget day, prompting accusations the government is trying to bury the document.

items.title: Jacinta Nampijinpa Price leads emotional tributes for Kumanjayi Little Baby
items.description: Senator Jacinta Nampijinpa Price weeps through an impassioned tribute to her niece, Kumanjayi Little Baby, in federal parliament, amid a push to broaden the focus of an inquiry announced in the wake of her alleged murder.

items.title: Native duck species at risk of disappearing, conservationists warn
items.description: The crossbreeding of Pacific black ducks with introduced species has devastated the native species in New Zealand — and conservationists say there's a risk that's happening in Tasmania too.

items.title: Sinner equals Djokovic's 31-match Masters record at Italian Open
items.description: World number one Jannik Sinner extended his Masters 1000 winning streak to 31 matches, equalling Novak Djokovic's all-time record.
